claims.claim: Registers a read replacement that delegates targeted reads and recognized binary files to Pi's built-in read tool.
Generates maps only when a file exceeds 2,000 lines or 50 KiB.
Caches formatted maps by file modification time and appends the map to the ordinary read result.
Dispatches supported formats to language-specific mappers including TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Go, Rust, C, C++, Clojure, SQL, JSON, JSONL, Markdown, YAML, TOML, and CSV.
Falls back from a language mapper to ctags and then to text-based extraction when needed.
Reduces maps through full, compact, minimal, and outline tiers before truncating the symbol selection to fit the hard budget.
Credits Kevin's Codemap as inspiration and a foundation, and separately credits Baishampayan Ghose for the Clojure mapper contribution.
Identifies the C++ mapper as ported from Codemap.
Identifies the Rust mapper as ported from Codemap.
